_note: Proposed by BE-C for F05 package-only Pay (D81). Numbers to be assigned by Content; wording drafted, writers own it. P-new.package_line labels a package line on C10P, C11P and the receipt (the product's own name is shown beside it). Reused: P-new.student_too_old (locales/pending/f02.json) for a Student package refused by age. A-new.cash_* are the refusals of POST /staff/orders/:id/cash (F05 §5.6); A-0058 (Cash reason, required) is reused.

en.P-new.package_not_for_sale: This package is not available to buy right now. Please contact the club.
en.A-new.cash_bad_input: Something in this cash payment is not right. Check the reason and try again.
en.A-new.cash_note_required: Add a note for the reason Other.
en.A-new.cash_club_paused: Online booking is paused, so no payment can be taken now.
en.A-new.cash_order_not_found: This order is not open any more. Reload the booking.
en.A-new.cash_nothing_to_pay: There is nothing left to pay on this order.
en.A-new.cash_hold_ended: The hold on this booking has ended. Book the hour again.
en.A-new.cash_credit_unavailable: The player's credits or wallet changed. Book again to see the new price.
en.A-new.cash_coach_add_not_supported: A coach added to a booking cannot be paid in cash yet. The player pays with the QR.
